caption:
Reels and posts are not competing. They do different jobs.

This confuses almost every business owner I talk to, and it leads to a bad decision: dropping one for the other.

Here's the split.

REELS go out to people who don't follow you. That's the whole point of the format — it's a discovery surface. It puts you in front of strangers who have never heard of your business.

POSTS AND STORIES reach the people who already follow you. That's not a limitation. That's the relationship layer, where someone who already knows you decides whether to trust you.

Neither one is better. They're not even doing the same job:

→ Reels bring new people in
→ Posts and Stories keep the ones you already have

A business running only Reels builds an audience that never converts, because nobody ever gets to know them.

A business running only posts talks to the same small room forever.

You need both. The mistake is treating it as a choice.
